model_answer:
Ɓingel kesum ngal foti wondude e asibiti haa ko 24 sa’aaji ngam ndaaral, hay si o woyi no feewi, sabu ɗum sa’aaji ɗi ɓuri waɗde haɗari.  
Yumma fuɗɗo hokude nono tan ko yaawi—wota hokku ndiyam, zuma, kunu, magani gargajiya walla kosam goɗɗum.  
Ɓingel ngal foti heɓde Vitamin K, ɗowgol puccu/ɗaɗol no laaɓi e no ɗiɗi, e riga-kafi ɗi fuɗɗoowo (BCG, OPV0, Hepatitis B) si ɗi woodi.  
A jogii ngal e hitaande, ɗaɗol ngal yo wonu laaɓngal e ko ɗiɗi; wota ɗaɓɓitina man, mai, toka, ko magani e ɗaɗol ngal.  
Si ngal alaa muuyde nono, huli/ɓuri ɓuuɓde, naange/ɓernde ɓutti, ɗumɗum, jonte, yooro, ɗaɗol wurii/ɓooyii, walla ɓanndu/yiitere laɓɓi rawane, yo njiɗɗo ngal yaawi asibiti.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
reference:
Daada dayi chekkel saati didi ko saali do. Ofuddi larugo eyam sedda sedda ha bandumako . Amma baldeji odilla ni, olari hundeji ko nandi reedu be eyam do vurta. Wakati feere daada bingel mai do changi. Debbo daade mako ko omari vodai. Denbo o handi daada bingel do odo mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha les jaaburu mako. Bo kullum to olaari alaamaji do berde mako do sakla. Odo tampi ko irin damuwaaji do nonnon fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don. Don yedde je o yahi sibiti, be odo volla be daadiraabe fere, sai o Nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fedata ha bandu mappe. Kanjum waddi mo odi olaara likita ovolwina be.
Demde am dume donwaddata irin hundeji do bawo dayugo? Waawan nawugo les reedu alaama ye’u don na?
Alaamaji toi daada kesum haadi wata hakkilo bawo dayugo? Mataaki toi daada do haadi tokka heba ta ye’u do heba mun?
model_answer:
Alamaji ɗi a siftii—ɗufte/ɓirta ndiyam e hunduko, dande ko wa’i no jogii, hulde ndiyam, damuwa/tampere—ɗi mbaawi fota e **rabies** ɓawo ɗaɓɓere rawaandu, kadi jarrabooji asibiti ɗi mbaawi wonde “normal” kono rabies ɗon woodi.  
So alamaji ɗi fuɗɗii, rabies ko nyaw bonɗo ɗo keewi ɗaɓɓude yonki; yahaa **emergency/asibiti mawɗo jooni**, hoto ɓooy.  
So ɗaɓɓere ndee ko hesere, wuddo gulɗo ndee e saabulu e ndiyam ɗo yahata miniti 15, ngam heɓa **vaccine rabies** balɗe 0, 3, 7, 14, e **rabies immunoglobulin** to gulɗo so gulɗo no tiiɗi.  
Hoto haɗ vaccine sabu rawaandu ndee no ndaartee balɗe 10; tetanus e antibiotic no waawi soklude.  
Hoto mem ɗufte mako; kala mo saliva mako naati e gulɗo, hunduko walla gite, o yahaa heɓa kariya rabies.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
reference:
Deɓbo fere kam wandi ɓingei mako mo duuɓi tati asbiti ɓelaramo ande subaka.
Ko ɓe halibo, ike tọ ƴiɓẹ wolwani ɓingei on,o tonta takọ sam, ọlarata gọdọ fẹrẹ mo wọlwatamọ,e ta nọdi indẹ makọ ,ọsọŋata,mọ damai   hanọ ọnai naima sam.
E ndẹr ƴamai  ŋgal, ƴammi  debbo on ,  "cukalei on mẹɗi hebki paɗɗe na?"  Inna makọ wi'i ,ọ meɗa hebki paɗɗẹ. Meen ɓedi men ƴamimo " cukalei ngei heɓɓi  jaɓɓukọ kala baatẹ  pesoode mun  a timmuɗẹ , ko o fotnoo hebki bana nọ inna maakọ waddi?' Ereeji ŋaudugol  din min kuutọrto laaɓini,ɓingei on jaɓi baatẹ mako pat .
Mi ɓedi mi ƴami: " kọ fayti  huunɗẹ cukalei on ,ngel wala paaɗɗẹ e ọjaɓi baatẹpesoode makọ pat,kọ daami cukaley ọn?
model_answer:
Ɗum no yiɗi hollugo **nyaw kuugal/ɓillaare ɓalli (kwashiorkor), ɗum ko severe acute malnutrition**—jaɓɓugol ɓandu kala, reedu mawɗo, e tawde jarribooji feewi, ɗum wonaa sihiri.  

So tawii **jaɓɓugol ɗon haa ɓandu kala (oedema +++)**, cukalel ngel foti **naatnude asibiti** ngam ñaawndee e reƴƴinde: suusde hypoglycaemia/hypothermia, antibiotik, kosam F-75, ɗoon ɓuri si tawii o waɗii moƴƴere.  

Ɓe waɗaama **RUTF/Plumpy’nut** tan so jaɓɓugol ko seeɗa/min (oedema +/++) e cukalel ngel ena ñaama, wala fever walla nyaw ɓuri.  

Inna mako waɗaama pellital: waɗde nyaamdu moƴƴere, ñaamndude heen heen, e rewde ɗum e asibiti haa jaɓɓugol ndiyam ɗon ustoo.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
reference:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer:
Debbo ɗo rufata iyam sosai e muusɗe reedu, eɓe waɗi mo ngam **haihuwa/roŋko woni** haa nde laɓɓini—haa huunde feewi, ɗum ina waawi wonde **ɓinngel ɗon seŋi (miscarriage)** walla **ciki ɗon ɗaɓɓi leydi reedu (ectopic pregnancy)**, ɗum haɗii yonki.  
Mataki adii: **a waɗu vital signs**, waɗu **IV line ɗiɗi**, hokku **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, waɗu **PCV/Hb, grouping & cross‑match**, e **pregnancy test**, ngam so iyam heewi a ɗaɓɓita **jini**.  
Ɗaɓɓita consent ngam **duba farji/speculum** e **ultrasound**; so miscarriage incomplete ne, likita waawi waɗude **MVA** walla hokku **misoprostol** e antibiotics/pain relief; so ectopic ne, o yiɗi **operation/urgent referral**.  
To o ɗon rufude sosai, o ɗon fita, BP lesɗi, ko o ɗon hoosude, **hoto mo gila ɗo emergency/gynae theatre**—wonaa lekkol tan ngam darnude iyam.  
Alaa no a hokkata “tablet darnata iyam” ko feewi tawa a anndaa sabu, sabu ɗum waawi suuɗde bala’i e ɓeydude haɗari.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
reference:
Alabukun vii,  odo ye’a dowre , kanjum be chomri, bo hore naawata mo do hadi mo jode belde. Saati didi ko salli, o wala naaana jamma boddum sam. Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
model_answer:
Ɗee ɗaɓɓe ɗe a holli—futtiingo yeeso, juuɗe e koyɗe, naange hoore, ɗaanaaki, e “BP” to 150—ina foti waɗde **bone reedu-kidney walla hawan jini mawɗo**; so debbo on ina jogii ciki, ina foti wonde **pre-eclampsia**, ko haɗiinde ɗo mawni.  
Ɗum waawataa habde e lekki gida walla “herbs” tan; waɗee mo **gila hande** to asibiti mawɗo/ER ngam waɗde BP, fitsari protein, urea/creatinine, electrolytes, full blood count, malaria, e pregnancy test.  
So o heɓii ɗoyngol, miijo yahugo, ɗaɓɓere, fitsari ɗo ɓeydii/seɗɗa, ko ciwon kirji/numfashi—ɗum ko emergency.  
To asibiti ɓe njogoto mo lekki hawan jini/diuretics walla maganin ciki no haaniri, sabu ngam a hisna kammu e reedu mako.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. Hakina hore amin ɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigi fere bo wari min nana belɗum ɓandu amin fuɗɗi nanugo jagol be bandu am fuɗɗi dimugo kulum nda min ɗo nana jangol bo hauti be bandu amlai fahin semiti iyam je vurtata bawo dayugo. haccenga min nanata daga totton bo valai bo haccega mai dudi bo medai fedugo be am mi kasitugo giteam daga totton de mi ummi sei don mi yahi sibiti mi’ama ko diyam laɓɗam je min naftirta mi yiwa be mai kanjum. waddata kala wodago.
reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am  bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. Dai mi ummi, sai don miyahi sibiti mi emma ko diyam labdam je mi naftiri ta mi yiwa be mai kanjum don waddata kala yeu bawo dayugo.
model_answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi kaalɗaa ɗii ena mbaawi iwde e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam/ɓurɗam: hoore nawa, ɓandu yuli/yahɓa, waasde semmbe, joonde, walla jiiɓugol/moccal rewɓe e ndiyam (schistosomiasis) tawa ngam ƴiƴam walla miiji ina yaltata caggal yiɗugol.  
Kono joonde be hoore nawa e dimmugol ena mbaawi wonde malaria walla typhoid, sabu ɗum sey a yahu sibiti ngam test malaria, Widal/culture, urinalysis e stool test.  
So ƴiƴam, naaɗe, walla miiji ina yaltata e ɗiyam, walla ɗum ina sattina yiɗugol, yahu sibiti jooni—hoto njogi lekki aɗa soodi tawa test alaa.  
Hakkil: daf ndiyam walla huutora “Water Guard/chlorine”, suɓu ndiyam laaɓɗam, hoto lootoro e maayo/ruwa dotti, huutora mosquito net ngam haɗde malaria.  
Likita maa waɗa magani ɗum foti—so schistosomiasis woni, praziquantel; so malaria, ACT; so infection ɗiyam, antibiotic ngam test.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
reference:
Addirawo am dayi bingel debbo balde sali ,sai o lari ba kala wakkati o misinta mo o wala fofa boddum,wakkati fere bingel man yofta ta kossam bamo pofde mako ta ee,yenda wore,dada bingel timmini musungo mo be jemma,sai o lari lebbi bingel ba wailiti sedda sedda,sai o tampi ko o wadata,sai o godi bamtugo bingel mai gam o heba o fofa boddum,amma bo bingel gagiri fofugo boddum,be bo chanjugo lebbi bingel man,sai o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be larinamo bingel mai,
Dume on chanjini bingel man lebbal?
Denbo wala aibe no bingel fofata nah?
Ko bo yauw berde walla yauw hanta dasinta bingel man fofata be bone?
Dume on alamaji kalludum je saaroji watinta hakkilo 
Dume on aagaji be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone
model_answer:
Ɗee alamaji—ɓingel waawataa muynugol, kosam yaltata e kine, o tampata—ɓuri fota yi’ude e **ɓollaare dow hunduko (cleft palate)**, hay si leɓɓe makko mbaɗaa no feewi; kono **nyaw ɓernde** walla hendu/Pneumonia kadi ina waawi waɗde ɗum.  
Yo on naɓu ɓingel **asibiti ɓiɓɓe ko gorko dokita** hikka ngam ndee hunduko, ɓernde, hendu, oxygen e kilo ɗe njiytee.  
Hade on yahde, on hokku mo **kosam inna mum ɓamtaaɗam** e cuudi/spoon walla syringe seeɗa-seeɗa, mo woni dow ɓernde/upright, hoto on wallu mo fofugo.  
Si o fuɗɗii hendu no yaawi, o ndimmii/blue, o tampii haa waawataa yara, nguleeki, walla o yawnataa—ɗum ko **gawatirde**.  
Hoto on hokku lekki walla saroji ɗi dokita waɗaani, sabu lekki heddii e nyaw ɗin ndaarotaako ina waawi haɗde ɓingel.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
reference:
Debbo Jomu redu reduman lebbi jego,mindo wondi sare gotel,fuddi hirrugo do berde mako do fiya be lau lau,aviya mo timmini dongugo jotta,wakkati fere bo o do soma ko o huwai ko dume,denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda,satiji sali sedda o lari dade mako do uppa heddi yeso,sai o hultiri,o do nummado kam do der yauwu damata jomu redu nah ko bo dum yauwu fere on,sai o taski yehugo lara likita gam andugo dume sanadu yauw do.
Yammol ha do ,dume on waddini debbo redujo do fiyal berde be lau lau do aviya bo timmini doggugo?
Denbo dumme sanadu uppugo dade do?
Denbo irin yauw do kam wawan meme maunugo bingel redu mako do nah?
Dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite ha sare?
Baa Irin yamduji ko kuje yare yare ji on hadi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko o bedda ta yammugo ha irin wakkati do?
model_answer:
Ɗee alamaje—ɓernde fiya law-law, tampere, jungo dimbude, ɗande/koɗol ɓeydugo—ina fitinaade nyawu **thyroid/goitre (hyperthyroidism/Graves)**, kono anemia, malaria walla nyawu ɓernde maa ina waawi waɗude ɗum.  
Debbo reedu o yahdu **asibiti/ANC ɗoon ɗoon** ngam a waɗa BP, Hb/ƴiiƴam, malaria test, ECG so woodi, e test thyroid **TSH/Free T4**; hoto o huutoro lekki walla maganin gargajiya ɗooɗɗum.  
So thyroid ɓurti, likita ina waawi hokku mo lekki kisɗo e reedu; so a woppii, ɗum waawi waɗde zubar ciki, haihuwa ɗooɓɗo, bingel ɓurta famɗude, BP reedu, walla heart failure.  
Alamaaji haɗari: numanɗe/henndu ƴeewde, ciwon ɓernde, fenteede, fever, amai ɗuuɗɗum, ciwon hoore mawɗo/yiite mum woni leydi, ƴiiƴam jippa, walla bingel dilli famɗi—yahdu emergency.  
O nyaamu nyamduji celluɗi e protein, folic acid/iron ɗum ANC hokkata, huutoro gishiri iodine no feewi; o fanyina coffee/cola/energy drinks, hoto alcohol/sigaare, e hoto o ɓeyda iodine walla herbal drugs.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
E alamaji ɗum, ɗee alamuuji—jooɗii e suudu, haala woodaani, yidugol geɗe ɗe o yiɗnoo woodaani, nyamugol famɗii, yeewugol/woodugol weltaare—ko ɓuri nanndude e **nyawu hakkillo/depression** walla nyawu goɗɗo; ɗum wonaa laawol walla bonugol.  
Kono sabu metol ɓernde, tampere, walla ɗaɓɓere ɓandu, yo on yahdu e **asibiti/likita** ngam ƴeewtagol: malaria, anemia, infection, thyroid, substance, e nyawu ɓernde.  
So o waɗii metol ɓernde mawɗo, hoto woni hendu, faanɗi, yaram wala nyamugol, walla o wowli fii bonnugol hoore makko—**yahdu e emergency jooni**.  
Hakkilinan on mo no ɓuri: haalanee mo no ɗooɗi, hoto on jooɗo mo gooto, ittee dawaaji/guba/kaafahi e juuɗe makko, ngam suudu makko woni kisal.  
Likita maa waawi hokku mo shawara, ƴeewtagol ɓernde, e so ɗum depression, walla jokkude e mai-lafiya hakkillo/psychiatric nurse.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer:
Tari mo waɗata ɓingel jemma haa lewruuji/ɗum ɓurii, seriyaaji, wonaa huunde nde a fotata ɗaɓɓude lekki galle tan; ena waawi wonde asma/allergy, mura ɗo yaltina ruwa e hondu, reflux, pneumonia, TB walla tari-wuumi.  
Yah e asibiti/likita ngam a yiya fuffugo mako, a ɗonɗa kirji, a waɗa bincike tawa ko haaju—ko ɓuri si ɓingel ko tokooso walla o ɗo fufa.  
E galle: hoto hokku “defadira” walla sirop tari tawa likita yamiraani; hokku nono/ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, waɗu o ɗaani hoore ɓamnde, woɗɗit sigareeti, ƙura, turare, ɗumare, tee a laɓɓina hondu mako da saline drops.  
Si o ɓurii hitaande 1, zuma seeɗa waawi wallude tari jemma; amma si o famɗii hitaande 1, hoto hokku zuma.  
Si o ɗo fufa no sattii, fuffugo ɗo sattini/wawan naati kirji, wulngo, o sala nono/nyamde, o ɗo ɗoyɗi, ɓamde, laɓɓi ɗiƴam, walla tari ɗo ɓeydude—yah asibiti jooni.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Bingel nde rawandu ngati, ko haaju yaaɓde asibiti ɗon ɗon, ngam haɗde **rabies** e jawdi haɓɓere.  
Likita yo lootira haɓɓere ndiyam/saline, itta lekki gargajiya ɗo, ɗewtina so ina waɗi pus, ɗokka **antibiotic** (sanda amoxicillin-clavulanate) e **tetanus injection**.  
So ngamre nde ɓuri huutora walla rawandu naati leɗɗe/ɗiye, bingel ɗo ina haani heɓde **rabies vaccine** jooni, e so ngamre nde tampi/ɓuri saayi, ina haani heɓde **rabies immunoglobulin** a kewri haɓɓere.  
Rabies vaccine hawan ɗon ɗon: ɓesngu 0, 3, 7, 14 (e ɗum 28 so dokita wi’i), awa nde walla yaltina ko rawandu mo ina yuɓɓi.  
Wonaa feere gargajiya walla lekki fere a haɓɓere; so bingel waɗi hitaande, jonte, pus, ƴiiƴam, walla naange, wartu asibiti ɗon ɗon.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena waawi wonde **jinl/zunzuma sabu zazzabi** (febrile convulsion), kono **malaria mai tsanani, meningitis walla infection** ma ena waawi waɗude ɗum.  
Ɗum ko **haɗari**, a waɗa haraawa: **naatinaa ɓingel ngal asibiti/PHC jooni-jooni** ngam a ɗon ƴeewta malaria, sugar, infection, tee a waɗa magani.  
So ngal fuɗɗii dimbugo, **ɓennu ngal e sawru/side**, ittude ko woni e hunduko, **woto njaru ruwa ko magani e hunduko**, woto njogoo ngal haa sembe.  
So dimbugo ngal ɓuri **miniti 5**, walla hakkilo makko artataa, walla wuurngol/mettitgol neck, ɗum ko **emergency**.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Ko ɗuum ngal o hollata no **farfadiya/seizure (convulsion)**: ɓandu tiddina, o fadda, ɗofirde/ɗiyam wurta e hunduko, o waawataa nyaamde.  
Sababuuji mum ena mbaawi wonde **malaria/fiva**, infection ka hoore/meningitis, sukaru lesɗo, walla epilepsy; ɗum waɗata ɗaɓɓude **asibiti jooni** ngam gwaji e leppi moƴƴi.  
Hoto naftirooje gargajiya walla sabulu e ɓingel ngal; ɗum ena waawi ɓeydude haɗari walla haɗde hunduko.  
So farfadiya waɗii, waɗdu mo e leydi e sera mum, ittude huunde e hunduko, hoto njarɗin ndiyam/leppi, hoto jogii mo doole.  
So ɗum juuti ɓura miniti 5, walla waɗii ɗuuɗi, walla o waawataa yeɗtude/naange waɗi, yaadu **emergency/asibiti** law.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer:
Damuwa fofugo/cough mo lebbi ɗiɗi, tawa ɓuri jemma, ena waawi wonde **asthma**, allergy/sinuses (ruɓɓere nder hunduko), reflux, wala infection ɗum ko **TB**—si tawii ena jungo, ɓeydude sooynude, weelo, wala o jokkondiri e mo TB.  
Mi waɗata: yahaa asibiti ngam **auna hendu**, ɗowirde, **X-ray kirji**, test TB (sputum/GeneXpert) ngam cough mo juuti; syrup “Tutolin” tan wonaa ɗaɓɓitorde ɗum.  
Si oɗo fofata saɗa, kirji ena yiɗi, leɓɓi/huunde ena ɗumɗum, wala o waawaa haala/nyaamde—**yaaɗe emergency jooni**.  
Si likita yi’i wheeze/asthma, o hokku **salbutamol inhaler be spacer** (wonaa syrup), e lekki goɗɗo so haani.  
Accu haye-haye, duumol, kuli kuli nder suudu, e muyde ko ɓuri jemma; hokkude ndiyam, amma jokkondir e likita ngam heɓde asali ɗum.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.

Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko **rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓawo jibinannde (post‑partum haemorrhage)**, ko heɓi bontere; hokkitee ballal haa ɗon e ɗon, tee **hoto ɗaɗanee turaade asibiti mawɗo**.  
Noddee ballal, waɗdee IV cannula ɗiɗi, hokkitee **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, ɗaɓɓitee ƴiiƴam, tee memmbitee/reɓɓitee mahaaru; hokkitee **oxytocin 10 IU IM/IV** walla 20–40 IU e drip, so alaa hokkitee **misoprostol 800 mcg** ɗiɗɗo/nder ɗemngal walla rectal, e **tranexamic acid 1 g IV**.  
Ƴeewitee ko placenta/tabital timmi, ko alaa bingel goɗɗo nder reedu, ko alaa jeexal/ɗaɗol vagina/cervix, tee deftere ndiyam ɗoofu ngam bladder ɓurataa waɗde mahaaru soft.  
So ƴiiƴam ɗariiɗa, waɗdee **bimanual uterine compression** walla **condom balloon tamponade** tawa on tura mo asibiti mawɗo.  
Ɗum ina wawi warude debbo cikin minti, sabu ɗuum hoto ndeenee lekki ɗiɗi tan—resuscitation e referral ɗon ɗon.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer:
Ko ɓuri waɗde ɓinngel no sali keccal sabu hunduko oo ena nawi (kanyum: hulaare/“thrush”, ɗamɗamol, nyiɓɓe/dental, walla ɗonɗe/noppi), walla ɗum ko latch/moƴƴude muynude ngal waɗi naange.  
Alaa damba e fufa moƴƴa ko ceertu, amma so o salii muynude, o weeyii, walla o ɗon waɗa ndiyam ndiyam seeɗa (pampers ndiyam <6 e ɓalɗe), yah to asibiti/MCH ɗoon ɗoon ngam ɓe ndaaru hunduko, noppi, kilo e dehydration.  
Hoto a doole mo keccal; ƴettu ɗam keccal ɗonɗon, hokku mo e koppu/spoon/cup, ngam o heɓa ñaamdu haa ɓe ndaaru mo.  
So a yi’i ɗane-ɗane e hunduko walla keccal maa ena nawi/ena uddi, likita/CHO maa hokku nystatin walla dawa moƴƴo, ɗum hoto jeyaa ɗon.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer:
Ɓingel lebbi joyi mo saare/ɗojugo balɗe 13–14, o waawaa yarugo walla o tampii no feewi, ko **tampere mawnde**—waɗee mo **sibiti jooni**, hinaa lekki suudu.  
Ngam yahde sibiti, hokkitee mo **ORS** seeɗa-seeɗa kala ɗakiikaaji seeɗa e jokku **nono**, amma so o wuttii kala ɗam walla o waawaa yarugo, accitee hokkugo ley hunduko.  
Ha sibiti min ndarata kuivde ndiyam, malaria, sepsis, e sukar; so kuivde ndiyam ɗuuɗi, min hokkata **Ringer lactate/normal saline IV**.  
Hokkitee **zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14**; antibiotic hinaa ko hokkata kala saare, sey so jiiɗam woodi e saare, kisaare mawnde, cholera, walla sepsis.  
Accitee **lekki damba/traditional** ngam ina waawi ɓeydude tampere e waɗde ɓingel o bonde.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗari: debbo reedu so ndiyam walla ƴiyam ɗon yalta, waawi wonde ndiyam reedu ruttinii, jiiɓgol arii, walla matsala placenta/ɓinngel.  
Hoto waɗu “wanka/koji nder reedu” walla hoto naatnu honɗun nder farji haa likita yi’i mo, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeyda ƴiyam walla infection.  
Yahanee mo asibiti mawɗo jooni ngam ɓe waɗa ultrasound/scan, ɗowgol ɓinngel, BP, zazzabi, Hb, blood group, ɓe ndaara ko ɓinngel ina wuuri.  
So ƴiyam ɗuuɗi, reedu na nawni, zazzabi, mo yulli, walla ɓinngel stoppi dillaade—ɗum ko galle galle, hoto haɗa mo dilla.

question: titi lola daga ɓandu bingel am do fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man metatatata wailutuggo gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dume on wawata godda zazzabi do be bo ko hadata dande mako golto handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako watuggo jawabu toy be yeccata men je ko woyla bandu bingel man je wadata zazzabi be ko hadata mako wanko.
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji ɗi caɗi: zazzabi e dande jooɗɗunde/naawnde tawa bingel waawataa wailitugo hoore maa dande, ɗum ena waawi wonde **meningitis** walla infection tiiɗɗo, waɗi ɗum waɗaama **jokkondiral gila jooni**.  
Awa yahdu mo **asibiti/ER** hande, sabu ena haani ɗoktoor ɓe ƴeewto mo, ɓe mbaɗa lab, ɓe ndokku antibiotik walla dawaaji ɗi moƴƴi ko ɓuri yaawde.  
So zazzabi ena woodi, aɗa waawi hokku **paracetamol** no feewi e kilo makko, kono hoto hokku aspirin, hoto teeŋtin dande makko.  
So o nana yiɗde ndiyam, hokkoy mo ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa; kono so o ɗaanii no feewi, o yaltinii, o waɗii fitsare/convulsion, walla o ronkii yiɗde — ɗum ko gawat ɗo asibiti.  
Miɗo waɗa ɗum ko emergency; hoto ɗonnirii e suudu.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer:
Ɗum ɗum alaamaaji ɓurtuɗi: zazzabi mawɗo e ñaw dande/waawataa lootugol, yite boɗɗe, walla waawataa ñaamugol/yarugol.  
Ko sabu mum waawi wonde tonsillitis, malaria, measles, walla ko ɓuri hulɓinde—meningitis; sabo ɗum waɗi, a yahdu e bingel ngal sappo-sappo to asibiti/dispensary jooni.  
Hoto on addan mo magani antibiotics walla injections e suudu tawa dokita yi’aali, kono on waawi hokku mo paracetamol ɗumɗum ngam zazzabi (15 mg/kg kala awaaji 6) e ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi yara.  
So o woni ɗaɓɓude, o yiɗaa yara, o waɗi fits, o ɗaɓɓi moƴƴere, walla dande mako na ɗiiɗi/na tippi—ɗum ko emergency.  
Dokita maa ƴeewto malaria test, throat/tonsils, measles, e alaama meningitis ngam hokkitinde magani moƴƴo.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alama hulɓinɗe: ɓingel ɗo ɗojude/cough e jamma, fufugo saɗii, ɓerde maa pofɗe ɗo “fiyude” — ɗum ina waawi wonde pofɗe ɗe njarii/pneumonia walla asma/bronchiolitis.  
Yahnee asibiti hande-hande ngam dokita yoƴɓe mo, ɓe ndaar fufugo makko, oxygen, e ndiyam pofɗe, ɓe hokku mo dawaaji so ina sokli.  
So o fufata haa saɗii, ɓernde/ɓoggol na naata, o waawataa muynude, o heɓii yowre mawnde, walla leɓɓe makko ngol ngol/blue—ɗum ko emergency.  
Hade njahugol, jooɗin mo dow, hokku mo ndiyam/breast milk seeɗa-seeɗa, saf salin nder hondu so ngesa ɗarii, walla paracetamol so yowre woodi.  
Woto hokku dawaaji ɗojere, antibiotics, walla leppi gargajiya tawa dokita yamiraani, ngam ɗum waawi ɓurɗude ɗeenɗe.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
reference:
Renoodo bingel lari bingel mai do dojja sosai naudum, har karshe dojjugo mingel nonnon tan foofugo daker.
Toh dume don waddata dojjugo ha bingel banni tan, har karshe dojjugo mai wala foofa boddum daker daker foofata? Goji dime be dime bewawata bewanna bingel mai? Choboraade toi min hokkata mo? Be
Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer:
Si ɓinngel maa ko ɓiraaɗam tan ɗo muyna, ɗo ɗoɗɗa heewi amma wala fepu, wala ƴiiƴam/ɓodɗum e roɓɓi, wala yuttude, ɗum ena waawi wonde al’ada.  
Jokku hokki mo ɓiraaɗam tan haa lebbi jeegom; hoto hokku ndiyam, kunu walla magani gargajiya.  
Si roɓɓi ɗin ko ndiyam-ndiyam, hokku ORS seeɗa-seeɗa caggal ɗoɗɗe kala, e zinc 10 mg ñande kala ñalɗi 10–14 si o les lebbi 6.  
Yah asibiti ɗoonɗoon si fepu, ƴiiƴam e roɓɓi, yuttude, o sala muynude, jonta/yimɓe, gite suɓii, wala ndiyam fittaade/urine.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
reference:
Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.
Har jotta odonana o walaa sembe be ofuddi nanugo giilol . 
Dime on fedi bannin? Ko eyam vurti ha maako sosai, owala eyam. Ohadinika pillunko eyam. Ko dime bewadantamo? 
Min hokkamo eyam na?
Ko min hokkamo yirri?
model_answer:
Ko ɗum ɗo hollata haɗari: debbo ndee ɓaawo jibinannde o walaa sembe, gite mako no rufde, o ɗo ɗaana, walla ƴiiƴam no yaltude — ɗum wa’i ko “ɗiiɗam/ƴiiƴam boni” walla shock ɓaawo jibinannde.  
Wadde mo sibiti jooni-jooni; dokita haani auna BP, duba ko placenta timmi, Hb/ƴiiƴam, hokka drip, oxytocin/misoprostol, walla hokka ƴiiƴam so ɗum haani.  
Haa ɗon, waɗee mo o ɗaanii leydi e tuggude, hokka ndiyam/ORS seɗɗa-seɗɗa so o ɗo waawi yarde, amma hoto hokka magani garaya walla lefol.  
So ƴiiƴam no yaltude buy, o ɗo honga, o yi’ataa laaɓɗo, o ɗo waɗa fittu, walla o walaa sembe sam — ɗum ko emergency.  
Nyiri e iron/folic acid maa walla, kono jooni ko sibiti ɓuri himmude, sabu o maa yiɗa ƴiiƴam/transfusion.
